// Positive control for [NS-33-R11] (BL-1841): an svg Image under another name, no prop. The Svg root is not a picture.
import Svg, { Image as SvgPic } from 'react-native-svg';
export function Bad({ uri }: { uri: string }) {
  return (
    <Svg width={10} height={10}>
      <SvgPic href={uri} />
    </Svg>
  );
}
